paite: Judah kumpipate, Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah leh Israel kumpipa, Joas tapa Jeroboam dam lai a, Beeri tapa Hosia kiang a hong tung TOUPA thu ahi.
heading: Hosia Zi Leh Tate
english: The word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

paite: Hosia zang a TOUPA'N thu agen masak lai in, Hosia kiang ah TOUPA'N, "Kuan inla, na zi ding in kizuakmi pi inla, kizuakmi tate nei in; gam in lah TOUPA paisan in kizuakna nakpitak in ahihta ngal a," achi hi.
english: When Yahweh spoke at first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in akuan a Diblaim tanu Gomer api a; ahong gai a, tapa aneihsak hi.
english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Amin Jezreel sa in; sawt lou nung chiang a, Jehu inkote tung a Jezreel sisan phuba la ding ka hi, Israel inkote lalgam ka tawpsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, Jezreel Phaizang ah Israel thalpeu ka kitansak ding," achi hi.
english: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

paite: Huan agai nawn a, tanu anei hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Amin ding in Lo-ruhamah sa in; amaute bangchi mah a ngaidam ding in, Israel inkote tung ah zahngaihna ka neih nawn louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah Lo-Ruhamah means “not loved.” ; for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.

paite: "Himahleh Judah inkote tung ah zahngaihna ka nei ding a, TOUPA a Pathian un amaute ka hondam ding a, thalpeu, namsau, kidouna, sakol, sakol tungtuang mite in amaute ka hondam kei ding hi," achi hi.
english: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by Yahweh their God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”

paite: Huan Lo-ruhamah nawi angolhsak zoh in, agai nawn a, tapa anei hi.
english: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

paite: Pathian in, "Amin ding in Lo-ammi sa in; ka mite na hih louh ua, na Pathian uh ka hih louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi Lo-Ammi means “not my people” ; for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

paite: Hinapi in Israel suante zah tuipi piaunel, teh theih louh, sim theih louh bang ahi ding; akiang ua, "Ka mite na hi kei uh," chih a a-omna mun uah, hichi ahi ding a, "Pathian hing tate na hi uh," akiang ua chih ahi ding hi.
heading: Israel Tunding Ahi Ding
english: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured nor numbered; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

paite: Huchi in Judah suante leh Israel suante kaihkhawm ahi ding ua, amaute a ding in lu khat akiguan ding ua, gam a kipan a kuantou ding; Jezreel ni thupi ding ahi.
english: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.
